line: Crowley on Disks: Earth, the whirling Disk, Hé final on the Throne of the Mother, and the letter Tau (pdf p23, p24, p109, p225, p267).

sections.title: Earth and the Disk
sections.line: Crowley's attribution of Disks to Earth (pdf p24) and his statements on the Disk and the old conception of Earth (pdf p225).

quotes.quote: Nor are the Disks any more to be considered as Coins; the Disk is a whirling emblem.
the old conception of the Earth as a passive, immobile, even dead, even “evil” element, had to go.

sections.title: Hé final on the Throne of the Mother
sections.line: Crowley on the Earthy component, Hé final, the Daughter (pdf p225) and his diagram of the four suits and the four Elements (pdf p267).

quotes.quote: the Earthy component, Hé final, the Daughter, is set upon the Throne of the Mother
This diagram shows the attribution of the four Suits of the pack to the four Elements.

sections.title: The letter of Earth
sections.line: Crowley on Tau as the last letter of the alphabet (pdf p23) and on earth thrust upon the symbol (pdf p109).

quotes.quote: represented by the last letter of the alphabet, Tau.
the element of earth was thrust upon the symbol.
